summary: Robert F. Kennedy Jr., raised amid the pressure and tragedies of the Kennedy dynasty, went from heroin addiction and environmental law to leading US anti-vaccine activism, including a campaign tied to Samoa's deadly 2019 measles epidemic.

evidence.note: family history opens with Patrick Kennedy leaving County Wexford for Boston in the late 1840s
long segment on Joe Kennedy Sr.: banking, Hollywood, shorting the 1929 crash, SEC, ambassadorship
RFK Jr. born January 1954; lifetime rule anchors the span
host names the Kennedy dynasty itself as the main bastard of the series
Ethel beats the boys and repeatedly throws them out of the family home after RFK's murder
1974 Apurimac river expedition in southern Peru with Lem Billings
1983 heroin overdose on a plane diverted to Rapid City, arrest and probation
1998-99 harassment and groping of babysitter Eliza Cooney
marriage to Mary Richardson, mutual violence claims, her 2012 suicide
mercury fixation becomes vaccine conspiracy belief via Wakefield and Bigtree
Children's Health Defense campaign in Samoa, MMR pause, 83 measles deaths mostly young children
2024 independent presidential run and call with Trump bring the story to release

notes: Host frames the Kennedy dynasty as the real bastard, so inequality-class is primary with public-health close behind; the family is a secondary group subject. Covered span starts with Patrick Kennedy's late-1840s emigration (family history about 6% of airtime). Main span starts at birth since childhood fills parts 1-2. Transcript dates his Rolling Stone/Salon vaccine article to 2011; it ran in 2005.
